eligibility.evidence: Sections 4.2-4.3 and 6: GPT-3.5 (fine-tuned and prompted, text-davinci-003, temperature 0) classifies the news frame of 1786 Covid-19 anti-vaccine headlines against human annotator labels. This is a journalism annotation task from Entman's frame analysis, not a cognitive-experimental paradigm; fails E2.

A.title: Framing the News: From Human Perception to Large Language Model Inferences
A.venue: ACM International Conference on Multimedia Retrieval (ICMR 2023)

G.notes: Excluded at full text: LLM as annotation tool for news frame classification, no cognitive paradigm. Only a post-hoc remark links subjectivity to the psychological lens model; no experimental task is administered to the model.
